title: introduce-slo-seatbelt-and-queue-deny-tracer-hotpatch
author: Asha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Recent incidents (SUP-5042) exposed a failure mode where tenant bursts could starve small, latency-sensitive routes because our SLO enforcement allowed aggressive queue admission without short-circuit detection. This PR adds a lightweight "slo seatbelt" admission policy plus a deny-tracer that records short-circuited requests and a transient queue-deny path to prevent noisy tenants from triggering regional egress saturation.

What this changes (single-string summary): Adds an admission limiter that enforces per-route soft SLO thresholds (a tokenized seatbelt counter), a short-circuit deny tracer for telemetry, a fast-path queue deny implementation to avoid queue growth under overload, and an emergency hotpatch config toggle to opt routes into the seatbelt at runtime. Also includes small telemetry and dashboard updates to surface denial reasons and tenant cohorts.

Design notes: The seatbelt is intentionally conservative: it tracks an exponentially decayed token budget per route/route-variant keyed by model + seq distribution. When tokens are exhausted we prefer a deterministic deny (with optional hedged fallback) instead of allowing queueing that would violate the SLO. The deny-tracer emits minimal structured events (route, tenant_cohort, deny_reason, quota_snapshot) to the existing telemetry pipeline and tags them for the new dashboard. The queue deny path is implemented as a micro-eviction in the serving runtime to avoid allocations during high pressure.

Safety and rollback: The feature is behind two runtime toggles: feature.slo_seatbelt.enabled (global) and route.metadata.seatbelt (per-route). Both default to off. The hotpatch includes an emergency valve script in ops/scripts/ that reverts the per-route flag in < 30s. Rollback plan documented in the PR notes.

Testing: Unit tests for token decay and seatbelt accounting included. Integration test simulates bursty tenants against a latency-sensitive route and asserts 95th latency remains within SLO when seatbelt engaged. CI initially failed a flaky telemetry test; fixed by increasing test harness timeout and adding a deterministic timestamp stub.

Checklist: 
- [x] Feature gates added and documented
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] Telemetry events and dashboard atoms
- [x] Ops hotpatch script and runbook update
- [x] Security review not required (no new external surface)

Related: This complements existing load-shedding primitives and regional fallbacks by providing a pre-queue admission control that avoids cascading queue growth and subsequent regional failovers. See ENG-4882 for follow-ups (adaptive seatbelt tuning).
commit_summary: c1a9dd8: runtime: add slo seatbelt admission policy and config gate
a7b2f44: runtime: implement fast-path queue deny and micro-eviction hook
d3f7b12: telemetry: add deny tracer proto and mapper to common pipeline
8e4c901: ops: add hotpatch script and runbook snippet for emergency toggles
b0f9e67: tests: unit + integration for seatbelt accounting and latency guard
f2d6a90: docs: update runtime feature flags and console notes
diff_snippets: runtime/admission/seatbelt.go: +struct Seatbelt { tokens int64; lastRefill int64 }
runtime/eviction/queue_denier.go: +func DenyOrHedge(req Request) (Decision, Reason) { if seatbelt.Exhausted(req.Route) { tracer.EmitDenial(...); return Deny, ReasonSeatbelt } }
telemetry/events/deny_tracer.proto: +message DenyEvent { string route = 1; string tenant = 2; string reason = 3; int64 timestamp = 4; }

ops/scripts/hotpatch-toggle-seatbelt.sh: +#!/bin/bash
# toggle per-route seatbelt flag via control plane
redwoodctl route update --route $1 --set seatbelt=false

Fiona Liu: Integration test looks good but it was fragile in CI. Can we reduce timing dependence?
Asha Kapoor (author): Replaced wall time sleeps with deterministic tick injection in the test harness; added a single extra assertion for telemetry emit to avoid race.
Marcus Nguyen: Approve after resolving telemetry namespace collision (deny_tracer vs existing denial_event).

merge_details: Merged by Marcus Nguyen on 2026-03-02 using squash merge. Commit message: 'introduce slo seatbelt + deny tracer (hotpatch) — fixes SUP-5042; adds runtime gate and ops hotpatch'. Post-merge actions: staged rollout enabling route.metadata.seatbelt=false by default; monitoring alerts set to watch denied_tokens_total and 95th latency for seeded routes.
